vBRIEFInfo.description: Release-blocker fix: adapt build-dist to archiver v8 class API so the dist artifact builds

plan.title: Fix release dist build under archiver v8 (factory API removed)

narratives.Description: The v0.63.0 release cut failed at the build-dist step with `TypeError: archiver is not a function`. archiver v8 (declared as ^8.0.0 in packages/core) removed the v7 `archiver(format, opts)` factory in favour of per-format classes (ZipArchive/TarArchive). build-dist.ts (added in #1860) still used the factory convention, and the archive unit test had been removed during #1860, so the break went uncaught until a production cut.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Require archiver via createRequire and destructure { ZipArchive, TarArchive }; instantiate the per-format class.
- Ensure the output dist/ directory exists (mkdir recursive) and reject on output-stream errors so a missing dir no longer hangs the build.
- Restore an archive-build test (tar + zip + main end-to-end) that actually produces an artifact, closing the coverage gap that let the regression land.
narratives.UserStory: As a deft maintainer cutting a release, I want the dist build to work under the declared archiver version so the release pipeline can package the framework.

items.title: Given archiver v8, when buildArchive runs, then it produces a non-empty tar.gz and zip without error.

narrative.Acceptance: buildArchive + main build real archives; build-dist-runner produces dist/deft-<v>.tar.gz.

items.title: Given a fresh project without a dist/ dir, when buildArchive runs, then it creates the output dir instead of hanging.

narrative.Acceptance: buildArchive mkdirs the output dir; output-stream errors reject the promise.

references.title: Issue #1860: full Python removal (introduced the TS build-dist port)
